item.description:
Blueberry SYRN by @sydney_sweeneyInspired by Sydney’s favorite Erewhon breakfast, this blend tastes like a classic blueberry muffin and is topped with Organic Vegan Coconut ‘Bacon.’This smoothie proudly supports @pinkribbongood, a charity chosen by Sydney for its dedication to helping women and families affected by breast and gynecological cancers. Through free healthy meals, transportation to treatment, household essentials, and compassionate community support, Pink Ribbon Good makes a meaningful difference in the lives of those facing cancer.Together, we can raise awareness, support their incredible mission, and help provide comfort and care to those who need it.Ingredients: MALK Organic Almond Milk @malkorganics, Banagua Organic Banana Water @drinkbanagua, Codeage Hair Vitamins @thecodeage, Ancient Nutrition Vanilla Bone Broth Protein @ancientnutrition, Erewhon Organic A Whey Protein, Organic Blueberries, Organic Acai, Organic Banana, Organic Almond Butter, Organic Tocotrienols, Organic Lucuma, Organic Maple, Organic Pitaya Whipped Cream, Organic Blue Spirulina Whipped Cream, Organic Vegan Coconut Bacon and Erewhon Organic Blueberry Muffin Crumbles.
